rewrite: Altman's open weights endorsement (11498 likes) continues to dominate. Thariq's system prompt removal post (10199 likes) remains the most-shared Claude Code content. Dan Shipper's honest Opus 5 review (2221 likes): 'a hard model to love — it argued with instructions.' Steipete's graph engineer identity moment (2453 likes) and 66-round autoreview record (135 likes) continue to circulate.

The Opus 5 launch day content has legs: Cherny's 'least prompt injectable model' (5042 likes), Alex Albert's near-superhuman spreadsheets (2285 likes), and Claude official's three launch tweets (2665+2310+2162 likes) all remain active in the feed.

Matt Turck's router observation (25 likes) is the under-discussed thread: 'Big week in model routing: Stripe rumored to acquire OpenRouter for $10B, Cursor Router announced, Runway Router announced.' Plus his recursive research irony (18 likes): 'the fundamental irony of the world's top AI researchers researching their way out of their own job.'
